home.title: Ontour | Day Trips & Tourist Circuits
home.description: Explore the best destinations, day trips and circuits with Ontour. Tourism in Colombia.

epoca-precolombina-sur-colombia.name: Pre-Columbian Era – Southern Colombia
epoca-precolombina-sur-colombia.description: A profound 9-day journey discovering the heart of Pre-Columbian culture, Andean gastronomy, the Tatacoa Desert, and the archaeological history of Bogotá, Tolima and Huila.
highlights: Prado Reservoir and the Pijaos tribe
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to hotel. Free time. Accommodation.
DAY 2: BOGOTÁ CITY TOUR & MONSERRATE. Panoramic tour of Bogotá's historic center, gastronomic experience in La Candelaria, and ascent to Monserrate by cable car with sunset dinner.

DAY 3: GOLD MUSEUM & SALT CATHEDRAL. Guided tour of the Muisca legacy at the Gold Museum. Departure to Zipaquirá to taste local cuisine and enter the Salt Cathedral (180 m underground). Return to Bogotá.

DAY 4: BOGOTÁ – EL ESPINAL – INLAND SEA. Travel to Tolima. Visit the mythological park in El Espinal, tasting of authentic Lechona Tolimense. Boat transfer to Prado Reservoir (4,400 hectares). Bonfire and stargazing.

DAY 5: PRADO – PIJAOS OF TOLIMA GRANDE. Tour of the reservoir (Enchanted Lagoon, Mohán's Cave, Morgan Island, Love Waterfall). Visit Purificación, Saldaña and Chaparral to meet the Pijao tribe. Transfer to Neiva.
DAY 6: NEIVA & TATACOA DESERT. Visit Villa Vieja (Paleontological and Artisan Museum). Hike along the Rainbow Trail, Los Hoyos, Valley of Ghosts, and swim in a natural pool. Return to Neiva.

DAY 7: SAN AGUSTÍN. 5-hour drive to San Agustín. 4-hour tour of the Archaeological Park (Mesitas, Fuente del Lavapatas, Forest of Statues). Eco-tour to El Tablón, La Chaquira and the Magdalena River gorge.

DAY 8: SALTO DEL MORTIÑO. Visit the 170-m waterfall and cross the Crystal Bridge. Entry to the Alto de los Ídolos archaeological park (burial mounds, monolithic sarcophagi). Lunch and return to Neiva.
DAY 9: NEIVA – BOGOTÁ. Transfer to Benito Salas Airport for flight to Bogotá. (Option to add an extra night in Bogotá, not included). End of services.

tour-colombia-corazon-andes.name: Heart of the Andes – Complete Colombia
tour-colombia-corazon-andes.description: An epic 13-day tour of the best of Colombia: from vibrant Bogotá to the Coffee Region, through Tolima, Honda and Guaduas. Culture, nature, gastronomy and colonial history in one single experience.
highlights: Bogotá city tour with dinner at Monserrate
Gold Museum and Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral
Combeima Canyon in Jeep Willys and cable car
Wax Palm Forest and Cerro Machín Volcano
Quindío Botanical Garden with over 1,400 butterfly species
Salento, Cocora Valley and Filandia with 360° panoramic view
Ascent to Los Nevados National Park at 4,000 m above sea level
Lost City of San Felipe de Falan (18th century)
Honda Heritage Town and Magdalena River cruise
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to chosen hotel. Free time. Accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ CITY TOUR & DINNER AT MONSERRATE. Panoramic tour of Bogotá: historic center, La Candelaria, historic squares and urban art. Ascent to Monserrate (3,152 m) by funicular and/or cable car. Dinner with panoramic city views. Accommodation.

DAY 3: GOLD MUSEUM & ZIPAQUIRÁ SALT CATHEDRAL. Guided tour of the Gold Museum and Muisca culture heritage. Travel to Zipaquirá: gastronomic experience and entry to the Salt Cathedral, 180 m underground. Return to Bogotá. Accommodation.

DAY 4: BOGOTÁ – EL ESPINAL – IBAGUÉ, THE MUSICAL CITY. Travel to the Department of Tolima. Gastronomic tour in El Espinal: history and tasting of authentic Lechona Tolimense. Arrival in Ibagué, the Musical City of Colombia. Accommodation.

DAY 5: IBAGUÉ – COMBEIMA CANYON. Visit to Combeima Canyon, buffer zone of Los Nevados NNP. Jeep Willys tour through Villa Restrepo and Juntas. Cable car over 300 m high. Visit to Finca La Rivera, viewpoints, guided hike and possible sighting of Nevado del Tolima. Endemic birdwatching. Accommodation.

DAY 6: IBAGUÉ – WAX PALM FOREST – QUINDÍO. Visit to the world's largest Wax Palm Forest in Toche. Jeep Willys tour around the crater of Cerro Machín Volcano (2nd most active in the world): ascent to the dome, sulfur hot springs and fumarole. Transfer to Armenia, Quindío. Accommodation.

DAY 7: ARMENIA – BOTANICAL GARDEN – PIJAO. Visit to Quindío Botanical Garden: over 1,400 butterfly and bird species and natural trails. Afternoon in Pijao: stroll through the streets, export coffee tasting and live folklore experience. Accommodation.

DAY 8: SALENTO – COCORA – FILANDIA. Tour of Salento: steep streets, colorful facades and viewpoint. Visit to Cocora Valley by jeep: viewpoints and horseback riding among remnants of the Wax Palm Forest. Afternoon in Filandia: typical coffee at the main square and Colina Iluminada viewpoint with 360° view of the three mountain ranges. Accommodation.

DAY 9: MANIZALES – LOS NEVADOS NNP – MURILLO. Ascent to Los Nevados NNP: sighting of Nevado del Cumanday, frailejones at 4,000 m, sulfur water springs and Lagunilla River waterfalls. Visit to Murillo, Tolima: colonial history, organic products and El Silencio waterfall. Transfer to Líbano, Tolima. Accommodation.

DAY 10: LÍBANO – LOST CITY – HONDA. Visit to Armero, Tolima: vestiges of the 1985 tragedy. 7 km jungle hike in San Felipe de Falan to the 18th-century Lost City: colonial gold caves and warehouses connected to Cartagena and Spain. Arrival in Honda. Accommodation.

DAY 11: HONDA HERITAGE TOWN. Tour of Honda: market square, Las Trampas street, cathedral, bridges and colonial cobblestone streets. Visit to Colombia's first hotel and first pharmacy in the Andes. Cultural afternoon with local graffiti artists and visit to the River Museum. Accommodation.

DAY 12: HONDA & MAGDALENA RIVER – GUADUAS. River cruise on the Magdalena: fauna, flora and artisanal fishing experience. Afternoon in Guaduas Heritage Town, birthplace of Policarpa Salavarrieta: main square and tour of Colombia's independence history. Accommodation.

DAY 13: GUADUAS – BOGOTÁ EL DORADO AIRPORT. Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to El Dorado International Airport according to flight time. Option to add 1 night in Bogotá (not included). End of services.

tour-colombia-boyaca-colonial.name: Colonial Boyacá – History, Culture and Nature
tour-colombia-boyaca-colonial.description: An 8-day journey through the historic heart of Colombia: from cosmopolitan Bogotá to the heritage towns of Boyacá. Art, archaeology, hot springs, lakes and crafts in a unique experience at the cradle of Colombian independence.
highlights: Bogotá city tour with dinner at Monserrate
Ceramic workshop with ancestral potters in Ráquira
Villa de Leyva Heritage Town: fossils, museums and blue pools
Lake Tota: Colombia's largest freshwater lake
Craft experience in Nobsa: weaving a Ruana with the grandmothers
Boyacá Bridge, symbol of Colombia's freedom
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to chosen hotel. Free time. Accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ CITY TOUR & DINNER AT MONSERRATE. Panoramic tour of Bogotá: historic center, La Candelaria, historic squares and urban art. Ascent to Monserrate (3,152 m) by funicular and/or cable car. Dinner with panoramic city views. Accommodation.

DAY 3: SALT CATHEDRAL – ANCESTRAL RÁQUIRA – VILLA DE LEYVA. Visit to Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral with audio guide, 180 m underground. Afternoon in Ráquira: experience with potters, clay ceramics process and personalized sculpture. Arrival in Villa de Leyva. Accommodation.

DAY 4: VILLA DE LEYVA HERITAGE & ARCHAEOLOGICAL TOWN. Tour of the colonial city: Fossil Museum (400+ Cretaceous pieces), Chocolate Museum, First Congress House, Casa Museo Antonio Nariño and Nuestra Señora del Rosario Church. Visit to Pozos Azules Lagoon and buggy tour through semi-desert terrain. Accommodation.

DAY 5: TUNJA – PAIPA HOT SPRINGS. Panoramic city tour of Tunja (Boyacá's capital): Plaza de Bolívar and Cathedral. Arrival in Paipa and evening visit to medicinal sulfur hot springs in the cold highland climate. Accommodation.

DAY 6: LAKE TOTA & CULTURAL TOUR. Visit to the Lancers Monument with live exhibition. Local dessert tasting in Iza. 1-hour tour of Lake Tota (white sandy beach, Colombia's largest freshwater lake). Visit to Aquitania, world capital of onion. Tibasosa: feijoa cultivation and personalized leather workshop with the community. Return to Paipa. Accommodation.

DAY 7: NOBSA – BOYACÁ BRIDGE – BOGOTÁ. Craft experience in Nobsa: wool Ruana weaving with the grandmothers and creation of a personalized ruana. Visit to the Boyacá Bridge in Venta Quemada, symbol of Colombia's freedom. Arrival in Bogotá. Accommodation.
DAY 8: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to El Dorado International Airport according to flight time. Option to add 1 night in Bogotá (not included). End of services.

tour-colombia-tres-ciudades.name: Colombia – Bogotá, Medellín and Cartagena de Indias
tour-colombia-tres-ciudades.description: A 14-day journey through Colombia's three jewels: cosmopolitan Bogotá, innovative Medellín and magical Cartagena de Indias. Colonial history, paisa culture, Caribbean beaches, urban art and unique experiences in a single trip.
highlights: Bogotá city tour with dinner at Monserrate
Gold Museum and Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral
Welcome dinner in Medellín with live show by Trío América
Graffitour in Comuna 13 with local guide
Boat ride and ascent to Piedra del Peñol in Guatapé
Flower carrier (silletera) experience in Santa Elena and El Picacho viewpoint
Cartagena city tour: Castillo de San Felipe and La Popa Convent
Full day at Islas del Rosario by catamaran with snorkeling
Swim in bioluminescent plankton at Playa Tranquila
Panoramic tour of Barranquilla and Magdalena River boardwalk
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to chosen hotel. Free time. Accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ CITY TOUR & DINNER AT MONSERRATE. Panoramic tour of Bogotá: historic center, La Candelaria, historic squares and urban art. Ascent to Monserrate (3,152 m) by funicular and/or cable car. Dinner with panoramic city views. Accommodation.

DAY 3: GOLD MUSEUM & ZIPAQUIRÁ SALT CATHEDRAL. Guided tour of the Gold Museum and Muisca culture heritage. Travel to Zipaquirá: gastronomic experience and entry to the Salt Cathedral, 180 m underground. Return to Bogotá. Accommodation.

DAY 4: BOGOTÁ – MEDELLÍN. Transfer to El Dorado Airport and flight to Medellín. Welcome dinner at the city's most iconic venue with live show by Trío América. Night tour of the Laureles neighborhood. Accommodation.

DAY 5: MEDELLÍN – COMUNA 13 – CITY TOUR – GRAFFITOUR. Visit to Pueblito Paisa, Botero Square, Parque de los Deseos and Parque de los Pies Descalzos. Metro and Metrocable ride to Comuna 13: local guide tour through its escalators, murals and urban art. Accommodation.

DAY 6: MEDELLÍN – GUATAPÉ & PIEDRA DEL PEÑOL. Tour of the Peñol Town replica. Boat ride across Guatapé Reservoir. Ascent of Piedra del Peñol (700+ steps) with 360° panoramic view. Traditional mountain lunch. Return to Medellín. Accommodation.

DAY 7: SILLETERA TOUR – EL PICACHO VIEWPOINT – EL POBLADO. Visit to a flower-carrier farm in Santa Elena: silleta making, paisa tradition and mountain lunch. Stop at El Picacho viewpoint. Afternoon in the Provenza area with Medellín's most exclusive restaurants. Accommodation.

DAY 8: MEDELLÍN – BOTANICAL GARDEN. 2 to 3-hour tour of Medellín's Botanical Garden. Free afternoon and evening. (Optional: El Cielo restaurant, chef Juan Manuel Barrientos – Michelin Star, not included). Accommodation.
DAY 9: MEDELLÍN – CARTAGENA DE INDIAS. Transfer to the airport and flight to Cartagena. Welcome dinner in the exclusive walled city with a fine dining dish facing the Caribbean Sea. Accommodation.

DAY 10: CARTAGENA CITY TOUR & CASTILLO DE SAN FELIPE. Tour of Bocagrande, Castillogrande, Clock Tower, Getsemaní and Convention Center. Visit to the Santa Cruz de La Popa Convent (the city's highest point). Entry to Castillo de San Felipe de Barajas and visit to the Blas de Lezo statue. Accommodation.

DAY 11: ISLAS DEL ROSARIO & BARÚ BY CATAMARAN. Full day by catamaran from Cartagena to the Rosario Islands: snorkeling in reefs, turquoise waters, white sandy beach and seafood rice lunch. Return to Cartagena at 4:00 pm. Accommodation.

DAY 12: PLAYA TRANQUILA – BIOLUMINESCENT PLANKTON EXPERIENCE. Overland trip to Playa Tranquila via Barú: tropical fruits, local lunch and sunset. At nightfall, swim in blue bioluminescent plankton in the sea. Night return to Cartagena. Accommodation.

DAY 13: FULL DAY BARRANQUILLA. Panoramic tour of Barranquilla: Puerto Colombia, Lighthouse, Castillo de Salgar, Mallorquín Lagoon, Vía 40, Magdalena River boardwalk and monuments to Shakira, El Tiburón and Joe Arroyo. Tour of Barrio Abajo, the epicenter of Caribbean folklore. Return to Cartagena. Accommodation.

DAY 14: CARTAGENA – RAFAEL NÚÑEZ AIRPORT. Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to Rafael Núñez Airport for flight to Bogotá or home country. Option to add 1 night in Bogotá (not included). End of services.

tour-camino-real.name: Camino Real
tour-camino-real.description: A 7-day journey through the historic heart of Colombia: from Bogotá to Honda Heritage Town, passing through the deep Tolima region. Colonial gastronomy, Andean nature, volcanoes, canyons and heritage towns in a single adventure.
highlights: Gastronomic experience in El Espinal: Lechona Tolimense inherited from the Spanish colony
Mythological Park of the Magdalena in El Espinal
Jeep Willys tour through Villa Restrepo and Juntas
Cable car through Combeima Canyon at over 300 m altitude
World's largest Wax Palm Forest in Toche
Crater of Cerro Machín Volcano, the 2nd most active in the world
El Sifón Hot Springs and frailejones in Murillo at 3,200 m
Honda Heritage Town: cobblestone city of bridges
Guaduas Heritage Town and Villeta, panela capital
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to the hotel and passenger registration. If the flight arrives in the morning, we will do a panoramic city tour of Bogotá. Otherwise, accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ – EL ESPINAL – IBAGUÉ, THE MUSICAL CITY. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure towards the Department of Tolima. In El Espinal, a gastronomic experience inherited from the Spanish colony and visit to the Mythological Park, setting of the legends and myths of the Magdalena. Transfer to Ibagué, Colombia's Musical City. Accommodation.

DAY 3: IBAGUÉ – COMBEIMA CANYON. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure towards Combeima Canyon, buffer zone of Los Nevados NNP. Jeep Willys tour through Villa Restrepo and Juntas. Cable car through the canyon at over 300 m altitude. Visit to Finca La Rivera, viewpoints, guided hike and possible sighting of Nevado del Tolima (weather permitting). Endemic birdwatching. Return to Ibagué. Accommodation.

DAY 4: IBAGUÉ – TOCHE – CERRO MACHÍN VOLCANO. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure to Toche to visit the world's largest Wax Palm Forest and its colonial houses. Jeep Willys tour through the crater of Cerro Machín Volcano, the 2nd most active in the world. Visit to the hot springs and the forest. Return to Ibagué. Accommodation.

DAY 5: IBAGUÉ – MURILLO – HONDA HERITAGE TOWN. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure to Murillo to visit El Sifón Hot Springs, frailejones at over 3,200 m and sighting of Nevado del Ruiz. Transfer to Honda via the road to Manizales. Arrival at Colombia's main colonial port: cobblestone city of bridges. Accommodation in Honda Heritage Town.

DAY 6: HONDA – GUADUAS – VILLETA – BOGOTÁ. Breakfast at the hotel. Panoramic tour of Guaduas Heritage Town. Departure through the eastern mountain range towards Villeta, renowned for its panela production. Transfer to Bogotá. Accommodation.
DAY 7: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time, transfer to El Dorado International Airport to board the flight to the country of origin. End of services.

highlights: Gastronomic experience in El Espinal: Lechona Tolimense
Salento: colonial town and Wax Palm
Cocora Valley and coffee farm with overnight stay
Recuca Park: coffee culture tour in Calarcá
San Vicente Hot Springs in Santa Rosa de Cabal
Panoramic city tour of Pereira and Manizales
World's largest coffee cup (Guinness World Record)
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to the hotel and passenger registration. If the flight arrives in the morning, we will do a panoramic city tour of Bogotá. Otherwise, accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ – EL ESPINAL – IBAGUÉ, THE MUSICAL CITY. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure towards Tolima. In El Espinal, gastronomic experience inherited from the Spanish colony and visit to the Mythological Park, setting of the legends and myths of the Magdalena. Transfer to Ibagué, Colombia's Musical City. Accommodation.

DAY 3: SALENTO – COCORA – FILANDIA. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure towards Quindío via La Línea highway with views of the central mountain range. Arrival in Salento: colonial streets, Wax Palm (national tree) and viewpoint. Arrival at the coffee farm. Accommodation.

DAY 4: COFFEE CULTURE TOUR. Breakfast at the farm. Visit to Recuca Park in Calarcá: tour of coffee culture. In the afternoon, visit to Pijao: colonial streets, viewpoint and main square. Return to the coffee farm. Accommodation.

DAY 5: PEREIRA CITY TOUR & HOT SPRINGS. Breakfast at the farm. Panoramic tour of Pereira, the city of eternal spring. In the evening, experience at San Vicente Hot Springs. Night in Santa Rosa de Cabal. Accommodation.

DAY 6: MANIZALES & VILLA MARÍA CITY TOUR. Breakfast at the hotel. Tour through Dosquebradas and route to Manizales: visit to the world's largest coffee cup (Guinness Record), Metropolitan Basilica and Chipre viewpoint. Metrocable tour through Villa María. Return to Pereira. Accommodation.
DAY 7: PEREIRA – EDÉN/MATECAÑA AIRPORT. Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time, transfer to Edén or Matecaña airport to board the flight to Bogotá. End of services.

tour-tras-leyenda-dorado.name: In Search of the Legend of El Dorado
tour-tras-leyenda-dorado.description: A 10-day journey following the route of the Spanish explorers through the heart of Colombia: Bogotá Botanical Garden, heritage towns, colonial Honda, the Royal Botanical Expedition in Mariquita, Los Nevados National Park, the Combeima Canyon, the Inland Sea of Prado and the water parks of Melgar. History, nature and adventure on the route of El Dorado.
highlights: José Celestino Mutis Botanical Garden in Bogotá
Guaduas Heritage Town: home of Policarpa Salavarrieta
Colonial Honda: gold export port to Spain
San Sebastián de Mariquita: seat of the Royal Botanical Expedition
Los Nevados NNP: frailejones at over 3,400 m.a.s.l.
Eco Glamping with views of the Nevado del Ruiz in Murillo
El Sifón Hot Springs and Líbano: birthplace of writers and philosophers
Ibagué: oldest Music Conservatory in Latin America
Combeima Canyon: cable car and Jeep Willys
Prado: Colombia's Inland Sea aboard the Nautical Chiva
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to the hotel and passenger registration. If the flight arrives in the morning, we will do a panoramic city tour of Bogotá. Otherwise, accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ – BOTANICAL GARDEN – GUADUAS HERITAGE TOWN. Breakfast at the hotel. Visit to the José Celestino Mutis Botanical Garden to begin the explorer's route of the Spanish expeditionary who celebrated the territory's biodiversity. Transfer to Guaduas, first heritage town: visit to the home of Policarpa Salavarrieta and the Convent of Soledad. Accommodation.

DAY 3: COLONIAL HONDA & SAN SEBASTIÁN DE MARIQUITA. Breakfast at the hotel. Tour of Honda: cobblestone streets, colonial architecture, Alto del Rosario Church, Magdalena River Museum, Alfonso López Pumarejo Museum and guided tour of the main gold export port to Spain. In the afternoon, visit to Mariquita: seat of the Royal Botanical Expedition, Colombia's first botanical garden, La Ermita Church, Painters' House and Santa Lucía ruins. Accommodation.

DAY 4: FRESNO – LOS NEVADOS NNP – MURILLO. Breakfast at the hotel. Route via Manizales to the border between Tolima and Caldas. Ascent towards the Nevado del Ruiz in Los Nevados NNP: frailejones at over 3,400 m.a.s.l. and panoramic views of the sulfur hot springs. Arrival in Murillo. Accommodation in Eco Glamping with views of the snow-capped volcano.

DAY 5: MURILLO – EL SIFÓN HOT SPRINGS – LÍBANO. Breakfast at the Eco Glamping. Visit to El Sifón Hot Springs in Murillo. Transfer to Líbano, birthplace of writers and philosophers descended from Europe and the Middle East. Visit to the main park. Integration night. Accommodation.
DAY 6: IBAGUÉ – THE MUSICAL CITY. Breakfast at the hotel. Panoramic tour of Ibagué: plazas, churches and the oldest Music Conservatory in Latin America. Live Colombian music show. Accommodation.

DAY 7: COMBEIMA CANYON. Breakfast at the hotel. Jeep Willys tour through Villa Restrepo and Juntas. Cable car through the Combeima Canyon at over 300 m height. Visit to Finca La Rivera: viewpoints, guided hike and possible sighting of the Nevado del Tolima. Endemic bird watching. Return to Ibagué. Accommodation.

DAY 8: PRADO – COLOMBIA'S INLAND SEA. Breakfast at the hotel. Visit to Prado: 4,400 hectares of freshwater. Waterfall of Love, Morgan Island, Enchanted Lagoon and Mohán Cave aboard the Nautical Chiva. In the afternoon, transfer to Melgar, the city of swimming pools. Accommodation.
DAY 9: WATER PARK – BOGOTÁ. Breakfast at the hotel. Visit to Piscilago water park: slides, zoo and pool afternoon. Transfer to Bogotá. Night in the capital. Accommodation.
DAY 10: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time, transfer to El Dorado International Airport to board the flight to the country of origin. End of services.

tour-santander-expedicion-aventurera.name: Santander Adventure Expedition
tour-santander-expedicion-aventurera.description: A 10-day journey combining cosmopolitan Bogotá with the extreme adventure of Santander: the Chicamocha Canyon, the heritage towns of Girón and Barichara, spelunking in the Cow Cave, rafting on the Fonce River and the Juan Curí waterfalls. Culture, nature and adrenaline in a single experience.
highlights: Bogotá city tour with dinner at Monserrate
Gold Museum and Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral
Girón Heritage Town: cobblestone streets and lime-mortar bridges
Santísimo viewpoint with 180° panoramic view of Bucaramanga
Chicamocha Canyon: 6.3 km cable car over the world's second-largest canyon
Curití: traditional fique craft workshop and Cow Cave (spelunking)
Barichara Heritage Town: craft workshops and stone-carved artisanry
Juan Curí Waterfalls and Level I & II rafting on the Fonce River
itinerary: DAY 1: BOGOTÁ – EL DORADO AIRPORT. Reception at El Dorado International Airport, transfer to chosen hotel. Free time. Accommodation.

DAY 2: BOGOTÁ CITY TOUR & DINNER AT MONSERRATE. Breakfast at the hotel. Panoramic tour of Bogotá: historic center, La Candelaria, historic squares, gastronomic experiences and urban graffiti art. Ascent to Monserrate (3,152 m) by funicular and/or cable car. Dinner with the best view of Bogotá. Return to hotel. Accommodation.

DAY 3: GOLD MUSEUM & ZIPAQUIRÁ SALT CATHEDRAL. Breakfast at the hotel. Guided tour of the Gold Museum and Muisca culture heritage. Travel to Zipaquirá: gastronomic experience and entry to the Salt Cathedral, 180 m underground. Return to Bogotá. Accommodation.

DAY 4: BOGOTÁ – BUCARAMANGA – GIRÓN – SANTÍSIMO. Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to the airport for flight to Bucaramanga. City tour with local community immersion. Visit to Girón Heritage Town: cobblestone streets, lime-mortar bridges and Minor Basilica of San Juan Bautista. Evening ascent to the Santísimo, an illuminated viewpoint with 180° panoramic view of Bucaramanga. Accommodation.

DAY 5: BUCARAMANGA – CHICAMOCHA CANYON PARK. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure to Chicamocha Park with stops at canyon viewpoints. Visit to the Santanderianidad monument and 6.3 km cable car ride over the Chicamocha Canyon, the world's second-largest canyon with nearly 2,000 m depth. Transfer to San Gil. Accommodation.

DAY 6: SAN GIL – GALLINERAL PARK – CURITÍ – COW CAVE. Breakfast at the hotel. Visit to Gallineral Park with guided tour. Transfer to Curití (Village of Weavers in Guane language): traditional fique workshop with local farmers. Visit to the Cow Cave: spelunking through tunnels and chambers of natural formations. Return to San Gil. Accommodation.

DAY 7: SAN GIL – BARICHARA FULL DAY. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure to Barichara, 'place of rest' in the Guane language and Santander's second Heritage Town. Tour of viewpoints by chiva, artisan craft workshops (fique or painting with natural clays). Colonial cobblestone streets, stone-carved crafts and craft beer at the main square. Return to San Gil. Accommodation.

DAY 8: JUAN CURÍ WATERFALLS – FONCE RIVER RAFTING. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure to the Juan Curí Ecological Park via the road to Charalá: descent down a 70-meter natural waterfall, specialty coffee tasting and tasting of hormigas culonas (giant ants). Stop at the Fonce River for Level I & II rafting on a 10 km course. Return to San Gil. Accommodation.

DAY 9: SAN GIL – FLORIDABLANCA – BUCARAMANGA. Breakfast at the hotel. Departure to Bucaramanga via the Chicamocha Canyon with stops at viewpoints. Visit to Floridablanca to taste obleas (wafers) with natural products. Arrival at hotel in Bucaramanga. Accommodation.
DAY 10: BUCARAMANGA – AIRPORT – BOGOTÁ. Breakfast at the hotel. At the agreed time, transfer to Palonegro Airport for flight to Bogotá. End of services.

Medellin-Magica.name: Magical Medellín
Medellin-Magica.description: Discover Medellín from the inside: explore its most vibrant neighborhoods, gardens, typical Antioquian cuisine and the most spectacular viewpoints of the city. A complete experience to discover the capital of Antioquia in a single day.

bogota-tu-casa-pasadia.name: Bogotá, Your Home
bogota-tu-casa-pasadia.description: Discover the magic of Bogotá in a day full of history, culture and gastronomy. Explore the impressive Zipaquirá Salt Cathedral, the colonial heritage town of Villa de Leyva and the colorful artisan streets of Ráquira. Complete the experience with a gastronomic tour of the region's most authentic flavors and an unparalleled panoramic view of the Colombian capital.

cascada-la-plata-pasadia.name: Tolima, Heart of the Andes – La Plata Waterfall
cascada-la-plata-pasadia.description: Discover one of Ibagué's most impressive natural treasures. Through an ecological hike, immerse yourself in jungle landscapes, rivers and mountains until you reach the majestic La Plata Waterfall. A nature-connecting experience ideal for hiking and adventure lovers.

Cali-es-donde-debe-estar.name: Cali is where you should be
Cali-es-donde-debe-estar.description: Discover and experience the salsa and culture of Cali in a day full of flavor and joy. Explore the city's most iconic spots, enjoy its typical cuisine and let yourself be swept up by the energy of the salsa capital.

Cartagena-Mas-Heroica.name: Cartagena, More Heroic
Cartagena-Mas-Heroica.description: Discover the magic of Cartagena and its surroundings in a day full of history, culture and gastronomy. Stroll through the walled city, explore colonial fortresses, vibrant plazas and colorful streets. Complete the experience with a gastronomic tour of the most authentic Caribbean flavors and an unforgettable panoramic view of the heroic city.

Santa-Marta-Naturalmente-Magica.name: Santa Marta, Naturally Magical
Santa-Marta-Naturalmente-Magica.description: Discover the natural and cultural magic of Santa Marta in a day full of adventure and discoveries. Explore the city's most iconic spots, enjoy its Caribbean cuisine and let yourself be swept up by the energy of Colombia's oldest city.

San-Andres-Islas-Vas-A-mar.name: San Andrés Islands, You'll Sea
San-Andres-Islas-Vas-A-mar.description: Discover the Caribbean paradise of San Andrés, the island of seven colors. Dive into its crystal-clear waters, explore its white sand beaches, browse the open-air shopping district and enjoy the vibrant Raizal culture in a unique experience in the Colombian Caribbean.

legalTerms.title: Terms & Conditions
legalTerms.subtitle: General conditions for the provision of tourism services by Ontour DMC Colombia.

general.title: 1. General Conditions
general.text: By contracting any tourism service with Ontour S.A.S. (hereinafter "Ontour"), the client accepts the conditions described in this document. Ontour is a travel agency duly incorporated under the laws of the Republic of Colombia, headquartered in Ibagué, Tolima, registered in the National Tourism Registry administered by the Autonomous Heritage National Tourism Fund (FONTUR).

bookings.title: 2. Bookings & Payments
bookings.text: Bookings are confirmed upon receipt of the corresponding deposit (minimum 30% of the total value). The remaining balance must be paid at least 7 days before the service start date. Payments can be made by bank transfer, Nequi, Daviplata, or cash at our office. Published prices are subject to availability and may change without prior notice.

cancellations.title: 3. Cancellations & Refunds
cancellations.text:
Cancellation more than 15 days in advance: 100% deposit refund.
Cancellation between 8 and 14 days: 50% deposit refund.
Cancellation less than 7 days: no refund.
In case of force majeure (weather, public order, natural disasters), Ontour will offer rescheduling at no additional cost or a credit applicable to future services.

responsibilities.title: 4. Responsibilities
responsibilities.text: Ontour acts as an intermediary operator and is not responsible for non-compliance by third-party providers (airlines, hotels, restaurants). All our services are covered by insurance and compliance policies. The client is responsible for carrying valid identification documents and informing us of any medical conditions or mobility restrictions prior to travel.

modifications.title: 5. Itinerary Modifications
modifications.text: Ontour reserves the right to modify the itinerary for reasons of safety, weather, public order, or provider availability. Any change will maintain the equivalent quality and scope of the contracted service. The client will be notified as far in advance as possible.

jurisdiction.title: 6. Jurisdiction & Applicable Law
jurisdiction.text: This contract is governed by the laws of the Republic of Colombia. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of the city of Ibagué, Tolima. The current tourism sector regulations established by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism apply.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
legalPrivacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

dataCollection.title: 1. Data We Collect
dataCollection.text: We collect the following information when you use our services or contact forms: full name, email address, phone number, city of origin, travel preferences and, in the case of bookings, payment information. We do not store credit card data on our servers.

usage.title: 2. Use of Information
usage.text: Your data is used exclusively to: process bookings and quotes, send confirmations and itineraries, communicate changes to contracted services, and improve your experience with relevant offers and content (only if you opt in).

sharing.title: 3. Information Sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We share information only with direct providers of the contracted service (hotels, transport companies, guides) and only the information necessary for service delivery.

security.title: 4. Security
security.text: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. Our website uses SSL/TLS encryption for data transmission.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.text: In accordance with Law 1581 of 2012 (Personal Data Protection in Colombia), you have the right to access, update, rectify, and delete your personal data. To exercise these rights, email us at gerencia@agenciaontour.com.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.text: We use technical and analytical cookies to improve site performance and understand how you use it. You can disable cookies from your browser settings, although some site features may be affected.

legalTourism.title: National Tourism Registry
legalTourism.subtitle: Ontour DMC Colombia is a legally registered agency with Colombian tourism authorities.
legalTourism.registryBody: Ontour S.A.S. is registered in the National Tourism Registry, administered by the Autonomous Heritage National Tourism Fund (FONTUR).

whatIsRnt.title: What is the RNT?
whatIsRnt.text: The National Tourism Registry (RNT) is a mandatory legal requirement for all tourism service providers in Colombia, as established by Law 300 of 1996 and Law 1558 of 2012. Registration guarantees that the company meets quality, safety, and legality standards required by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism.

guarantee.title: What does it guarantee for travelers?
guarantee.text:
By traveling with an RNT-registered company, travelers are assured that:
• The company has civil liability and compliance insurance policies.
• Services are operated under current regulations.
• There is institutional backing for any eventuality.
• The trip contributes to the sustainable development of tourism in Colombia.

fontur.title: FONTUR Autonomous Heritage
fontur.text: The National Tourism Fund (FONTUR) is the autonomous heritage that administers resources for the promotion, competitiveness, and sustainability of tourism in Colombia. As a registered agency, Ontour contributes to strengthening the national tourism sector.

legalFaq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
legalFaq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions from our travelers.

q1.question: How can I book a trip with Ontour?
q1.answer: You can contact us via WhatsApp at +57 316 538 6892, by email at gerencia@agenciaontour.com, or through the contact form on our website. An advisor will respond with a personalized quote.

q2.question: What is included in the tourist circuits?
q2.answer: Our circuits include ground transportation, accommodation, professional tour guide, entrance fees to listed destinations, and travel insurance. Meals vary by plan. Specific details are available on each circuit's page.

q3.question: Can I customize my itinerary?
q3.answer: Yes! We are a DMC (Destination Management Company) and design custom experiences. Contact us with your preferred dates, destinations, and budget and we'll create a personalized plan.

q4.question: Is it safe to travel in Colombia?
q4.answer: Colombia has made tremendous progress in tourism safety. All our circuits operate in established tourist zones and include insurance policies, professional guides, and certified vehicles. Your safety is our priority.

q5.question: What payment methods do you accept?
q5.answer: We accept national bank transfers, Nequi, Daviplata, and cash at our Ibagué office. For international bookings, we offer payment options via Western Union or PayPal.

q6.question: What is the cancellation policy?
q6.answer: More than 15 days in advance: 100% refund. Between 8-14 days: 50% refund. Less than 7 days: no refund. In case of force majeure, we offer free rescheduling.

q7.question: Do you serve large groups or companies?
q7.answer: Yes, we operate corporate groups, incentive trips, conventions, and school excursions. Contact us for special rates and customized scheduling.

q8.question: Are you legally established?
q8.answer: Yes. Ontour S.A.S. is registered in the National Tourism Registry (RNT 145702), administered by the Autonomous Heritage National Tourism Fund (FONTUR), and complies with all tourism sector regulations in Colombia.
